files.name: main.py
files.code:
import math
from datetime import date
from collections import Counter

print(math.sqrt(144), round(math.pi, 2), math.ceil(4.2))

d1 = date(2024, 2, 1)
d2 = date(2024, 3, 1)
print((d2 - d1).days)                 # 29 ngày (2024 là năm nhuận)
print(d1.strftime("%d/%m/%Y"), d1.weekday())

print(Counter("banana").most_common(2))

solution.name: main.py
solution.code:
from collections import Counter
from datetime import date

words = ['a', 'b', 'a', 'c', 'a', 'b']
print(Counter(words).most_common(2))
print((date(2024, 3, 1) - date(2024, 2, 1)).days)
